itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter6_verse1.title: Bhagavad Gita Chapter 6 Verse 1
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter6_verse1.introduction: This verse belongs to Chapter 6 of the Bhagavad Gita.
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter6_verse1.scripture_text: Bhagavad Gita Chapter 6, Verse 1 teaches disciplined action, inner clarity, and devotion to the Divine as a path to liberation.
itihasa_bhagavad_gita_chapter6_verse1.philosophical_explanation: This verse contributes to Krishna's teaching on dharma, yoga, and liberation.
